description: Return the AI-written summary of one 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 20-F: its key points, financial highlights and the risks or events it reports. The text is written by a model from FinancialMD's standardized facts and the company's own SEC filings only: no outside research, no news, no price targets, no buy, sell or hold view, no advice. Every claim lists the fact proof ids behind its numbers and the filing passage it rests on (accession, section, character span, quotation); data.grounding counts claims, cited and verified. When you repeat any of it, say it is AI-written, keep the citations, and never present it as reported fact, as an analyst's estimate or rating, or as investment advice. Other forms are not summarised, and a filing without a published summary answers not_found with details.status. Use it to see what a filing says before reading it; filing_document gives the filing itself.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

name: filing_summary

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { filing: { accession, form, filed, accepted_at, source_url }, artefact: "filing_summary", version, generated_by: "model", model, method_version, generated_at, disclaimer, sections, grounding: { claims, cited, verified }, versions } from GET /v1/filing/{accession}/summary.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: AI-written summary of one filing
